intent: A horizontal slider on a native range input: a pill track with a fill and a circular handle. Track and handle variants cover gradient, alpha, and gradient-stop use.
use_when: A bounded value with a draggable track (opacity, zoom, a gradient stop).
dont_use_when: A precise typed number — use NumericInput.

tokens.note: The alpha-track checkerboard uses hardcoded #ccc/#fff (a standard transparency pattern), so this component is NOT tokensOnly.

a11y.label: ariaLabel when the visible label lives outside the primitive.
